pageProps.title: Machandeul King Salt Grilled Meat Dongtan Branch
pageProps.review: This is a visit review of a Korean meat restaurant where I enjoyed aged raw pork belly, pork neck, and the essential menu item, soybean paste stew, at Machandeul King Salt Grilled Meat in Dongtan, Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Aged Raw Pork Belly", "rating": 4 } --- It was a bit greasy but delicious as expected. ``` ```menu { "title": "Aged Raw Pork Neck", "rating": 4 } --- I like pork neck better these days. ``` ```menu { "title": "Traditional Soybean Paste Stew", "rating": 4 } --- Soybean paste stew is an absolute must! ``` ## Review I visited the nostalgic Machandeul after a very long time. I like it because there are many things to wrap and eat together. As expected, delicious Machandeul. ## Pictures
